objective: FormField's Field owns every layout it is used in: a checkbox layout replaces the EmailPreference card's .preference > div exception with no visual change, and a row layout lets the search bar's box and Search button sit on one line.
acceptance_criteria: Start gate: FRONTEND-028 has merged to main and no other PR that changes frontend/ is open. The branch is cut from a main containing it.
Test-first: commit the failing tests alone before the implementation. They fail today because Field has no layout prop, the .preference > div rule still exists and the search bar is stacked.
Field takes an optional layout of 'stack', 'checkbox' or 'row'. With none given it renders exactly the same DOM and classes as today, and every existing caller passes none but the two named below.

Field layout='checkbox' keeps the DOM order, label then control, then hint and error, so describeField's ids and the label's htmlFor are unchanged. The box sits before the label, 20 px, the label fills the row as the hit area, the row is at least --target-min tall, and a hint or error takes a line of its own. cursor: pointer applies only while the control is enabled.

EmailPreference uses layout='checkbox'. Notifications.module.css has no rule whose selector reaches into Field: .preference > div, .preference > div > p, .preference input[type="checkbox"] and .preference label are gone, and .preference keeps only the card's own stack. Those rules' replacements live in FormField.module.css, and the static checks in notifications-style.test.tsx follow them there with the same assertions: the row wraps, the hint has flex-basis 100%, and every pointer rule is conditional on :enabled.

Field layout='row' takes a trailing action beside the control. The label sits over the control, not over the action, and the hint and error span the row beneath both. The control takes the remaining width and never shrinks below what its text needs at 360 px wide.

SearchInput forwards the layout and action to Field. StatsPicker's SearchInput passes neither and is unchanged. SearchBar uses the row at every width with no media query: the box then the Search button, in that tab order, the two the same height and aligned on their bottom edges. form role='search', the label, name, maxLength and submit behaviour are unchanged, and SearchBar.test.tsx passes with only its layout assertions added.

Identical before and after, by computed style and bounding rect within 0.5 px, at 360 and 1280 wide, light and dark, reported per row with its measurement or NOT DONE. Row 1: the email preference with the box enabled. Row 2: unavailable, with the disabled box and its hint on its own line. Row 3: a failed save, with the alert under the row. Row 4: the sign-in form. Row 5: create-profile. Row 6: profile settings. Row 7: the compose text box. Row 8: Stats > Players' search box. Row 9: the team search. Row 10: the picker's SearchInput and SeasonSelect.

Changes visually, reported the same way. Row 11: the search bar on / at 360 and 1280: box and button on one line, equal height, at least --target-min, scrollWidth equal to clientWidth, nothing clipped, the label above the box only. Row 12: the same on /search with a query. Row 13: keyboard: Tab reaches the box then the button, each with the focus ring unclipped by the card. Row 14: the search bar at 200% text size, no overlap, wrapping if the row wraps at all.

frontend/src/test/bundle-budgets/FRONTEND-029.ts declares, in the test commit, every output the unit changes: at most 256 bytes gzip of entry JS and 128 of entry CSS. It claims no output a still-unfolded FRONTEND-028.ts claims: if it would, the Director fold has to merge first, and the unit stops and says so.
No new dependency, no new icon, no change to tokens.css, no raw colours or px font sizes in module CSS.
wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x08-frontend.md records Field's three layouts and that the search bar is a row.
